Saturday Morning Gravel (The Bike Way / Omaha Velo)

Papillion, NE · Gravel

Saturday Morning Gravel (The Bike Way / Omaha Velo) is a gravel group ride in Papillion, NE. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Walnut Creek, south parking lot.

Next ride Sat, Oct 3, 8:00 AM CDT

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.
